clue.text: Watch your heart

definitions.meaning: a wristwatch, in old slang, is a ticking device
slang for the organ that beats in your chest

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep an eye on your own cardiac health.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a timepiece and the heart tick steadily, so slang names each after that sound.

clue.text: Psychedelic patterns at right angles to the nave

definitions.text: at right angles to the nave

indicators.note: psychedelic suggests swirling distorted visuals, so the letters of patterns are rearranged

explanation.surface: Trippy designs set crosswise to a church's main aisle.
explanation.definitionFit: In a cross-shaped church the arms running crosswise across the main body are this part of the building.

clue.text: Speed of star lacking brightness, initially

indicators.note: lacking means a letter is missing from the word for star

parts.note: a star is a famous person, a celebrity

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word brightness

explanation.surface: A question about how fast a dim star travels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' takes B, the first letter of 'brightness' picked by 'initially', out of CELEBRITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Celerity is a formal synonym for swiftness or rapidity.

clue.text: Draw out point within the law

parts.note: E, east, is a compass point
licit means lawful, permitted by law

explanation.surface: Extracting a point that stays inside the legal limits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within' looks like a container signal, but 'within the law' is simply a definition of LICIT.
explanation.definitionFit: To elicit a response is to coax or extract it, a synonym of drawing it out.

clue.text: Rat back initially on vessel

indicators.note: initially selects only the opening letter of the word back

parts.note: a lighter is a flat-bottomed barge used to unload ships

explanation.surface: A rodent clinging to the stern of a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: A LIGHTER is a barge for ferrying cargo between ship and shore.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal insults for a contemptible or annoying person.

clue.text: Bound to be an incline with no summit

indicators.note: in a down clue the summit is the top letter, so the first letter is removed

parts.note: an incline is a slope

explanation.surface: Something that is destined to be a hill with no peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no summit' removes the first letter, S, from SLOPE.
explanation.definitionFit: To lope is to run with long easy strides, much as an animal bounds along.

clue.text: Group with ferocious beast, nervy group

parts.note: a gang is a group of people
a lion is a fierce big cat

explanation.surface: A pack of people accompanied by a savage animal makes a jittery crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nervy' here means made of nerves, not anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: A ganglion is a cluster of nerve cells, so a group of nerves.

clue.text: Food of little importance?

parts.note: names a layered custard-and-sponge dessert whose name also means a petty matter

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a British sherry-soaked pudding and a thing of slight value.

clue.text: About to take soldier and me to the authorities

parts.note: re means about, concerning
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: Someone preparing to hand a soldier and themselves over to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A regime is the ruling government, those in power.

clue.text: How French take coffee with audible Spanish exclamation

indicators.note: audible means we want a phrase sounding like the Spanish cry when spoken

parts.note: olé is the Spanish cry of approval at a bullfight

explanation.surface: French coffee drinking described with a shout of Spanish enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: AU LAIT, French for with milk, is said much like OLÉ.
explanation.definitionFit: Café au lait is the French style of coffee served with hot milk.

clue.text: Sadomasochistic pastime is very good

definitions.meaning: smacking someone's bottom as part of kinky play

explanation.surface: A naughty hobby declared to be excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both smacking and, informally, splendid or brisk.

clue.text: Food supplied by muttering actors

definitions.meaning: a pink-stalked plant cooked as a dessert
the word extras repeat to sound like background chatter on stage

explanation.surface: Something to eat that a crowd of mumbling performers provides.
explanation.definitionFit: The stalks are eaten in crumbles, and actors say the word over and over to mimic indistinct conversation.

clue.text: There's no water, honest!

parts.note: the sea channel spelling is ruled out, leaving the same-sounding word meaning truthful

explanation.surface: Someone insisting there is truly no water about.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight means honest, and it sounds like strait, a narrow sea channel that the clue says is not meant.

clue.text: Devious course two students and Amos failed

indicators.note: failed suggests things going wrong, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: L is a learner, so two students give two Ls

explanation.surface: Two learners and someone called Amos flunking a tricky course.
explanation.definitionFit: A slalom is a zigzag ski course around gates, a winding route.

clue.text: As cheat is to teach a horse and sheep

parts.note: a nag is an old horse
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A riddle about cheating, teaching, a horse and a sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters of cheat rearranged give teach, so one word is a jumble of the other.

clue.text: Spread on head

definitions.meaning: a paste spread on toast, as the French pâté
an old word for the top of the skull

explanation.surface: Something spread over one's head.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters give both a meat paste and an archaic word for the crown of the skull.

clue.text: Jilt when wearing a ring?

parts.note: a band is a ring, such as a wedding band
on means being worn, as in having a hat on

explanation.surface: Asking whether to dump someone while still wearing their ring.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as A BAND ON: a ring being worn.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon a lover is to desert them, which is what jilting means.

clue.text: Guru imbibing spirit in primitive times

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so one word takes another inside it

parts.note: a sage is a wise teacher, a guru
tone means mood or spirit

explanation.surface: A wise man drinking alcohol in prehistoric days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spirit' looks like alcohol for the guru to drink, but here it means mood or character.
explanation.definitionFit: The Stone Age is the earliest prehistoric period, when people used stone tools.

clue.text: Vital support on hand?

definitions.meaning: a rope or aid on which survival depends
a crease across the palm read by fortune-tellers

explanation.surface: Asking whether essential help is close by.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a rescue rope and the palm crease said to show how long you will live.

clue.text: Predict dubious facts about raw material

indicators.note: about means going round, so the rearranged letters surround the other piece
dubious means doubtful or shaky, so the word facts is rearranged

parts.note: ore is unrefined rock from which metal is taken

explanation.surface: Forecasting from questionable figures about natural resources.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dubious' rearranges the letters of the fodder, and 'about' wraps that jumble round the mined substance; 'raw material' tempts a cotton-or-wool reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To forecast is to foretell or estimate what will happen.

clue.text: Depository is so great for assembly

indicators.note: for assembly says the letters given need putting together into a new order

explanation.surface: Praising a warehouse as wonderful for putting things together.
explanation.definitionFit: A depository is a place for keeping goods, a store.

clue.text: Drunkard to lose everything?

parts.note: winning nothing, a nil score, means losing all

explanation.surface: A heavy drinker who risks losing it all.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as WIN O: to win zero is to lose everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A wino is a down-and-out alcoholic who drinks cheap wine.

clue.text: Nipper provides a little clap in ceremony

indicators.note: a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A child who claps briefly at a formal event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nipper' looks like British slang for a small child; here it is a thing that nips.
explanation.definitionFit: A pincer is a claw, as on a crab, that grips and nips.

clue.text: Office having to polish up on vital stuff in France

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: to rub is to polish
eau is French for water, essential to life

explanation.surface: An office that needs a polish and some essentials from France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RUB into BUR in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A bureau is an agency or department, as in a travel bureau.

clue.text: Food for important person

definitions.meaning: a dairy product made from curdled milk

explanation.surface: Something to eat for a VIP.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a dairy food and, as in big cheese, slang for a boss.

clue.text: Lizard from Caribbean island removing insect to North America

indicators.note: removing means a piece is taken out of the island's name

parts.note: Antigua is an island in the West Indies
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A lizard from the West Indies relocating an insect to America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removing' takes ANT from ANTIGUA, leaving IGUA.
explanation.definitionFit: The iguana is a large tropical American lizard.

clue.text: Money only material

parts.note: cash is money
mere means only, nothing more than

explanation.surface: A claim that money is only matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is a fine soft wool fabric from goats.

clue.text: Sweet to make money

explanation.surface: Something sugary used to earn cash.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a peppermint sweet and, as a verb, to manufacture coins.

clue.text: Climber in rocky climates

indicators.note: rocky means unsteady, so the letters of climates are shaken up

explanation.surface: A mountaineer in harsh weather conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climber' suggests a mountaineer; it is a climbing plant. 'rocky' rearranges CLIMATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Clematis is a flowering vine that climbs walls and trellises.

clue.text: On the subject of girl, bit of a looker

parts.note: re means concerning, on the subject of
Tina is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Talk about a girl who is rather attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looker' suggests a pretty person but means an eye.
explanation.definitionFit: The retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.

clue.text: Sort of wheel allowed in road

indicators.note: in places the word for allowed inside the word for road

parts.note: a route is a road or way
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A wheel that may be used on the highway.
explanation.definitionFit: A roulette wheel spins in the casino gambling game.

clue.text: Choose last of ladies in waiting

indicators.note: last of takes only the final letter of the word ladies

parts.note: elect after a title means chosen and waiting to take office

explanation.surface: Picking the final lady-in-waiting.
explanation.walkthrough: ELECT, as in president-elect, describes someone chosen but not yet in office.
explanation.definitionFit: To select is to pick out from several.
